svg.title: Coupling and cohesion
svg.desc: A ticketing site built two ways. In the distributed monolith a checkout calls orders, seats, payments and events in a chain, so when events is slow every service waits and checkout times out, and a new presale column in the shared database means all four redeploy. With loose coupling, orders and seats are one service with its own data and a copy of the sale window, so checkout succeeds and the change ships in events alone.
svg.text: Coupled, a slow service or a new column hits all four. Loose, it stays local.
